絶望の象徴が、目の前にいた。: The embodiment of despair stood before me.
光の翼を持つ、あまりにも美しく、<br>そしてあまりにも冒涜的な、天使の姿をした:
A 'calamity' in the form of an angel with wings of light—so beautiful,
and yet so profane.
こいつが、お前の言う『最高傑作』か？: Is this the 'masterpiece' you speak of?
ああ。人の『嘆き』を喰らい、人の『祈り』を絶望へと変える、我が愛し子。<br>新:
Yes. It devours people's 'laments' and turns people's 'prayers' into despair—my beloved child.
The new calamity: the 'Seraph of Lament'.
そうだ。これは、今までの厄災のような、<br>力でねじ伏せる暴力装置ではない。:
That's right. This is not, like the calamities before it,
a brute-force engine that crushes everything with power.
人の心に巣食う『悲しみ』に共鳴し、<br>それを増幅させ、所有者のいない『絶望』:
It resonates with the 'sorrow' nesting in human hearts,
amplifies it, and sublimates it into ownerless 'despair'.
そして、その絶望を糧に、無限に力を増していくのだ。<br>……この、私のように。:
And it feeds on that despair to grow its power infinitely.
...just like me.
さあ、最初の『餌』は、どこだと思う？: So, where do you think the first 'bait' will be?
あの前線基地にいる、か弱き者たちの嘆きを喰らわせれば、<br>どのような美しい絶:
If it feasts on the laments of the weak at that frontline base,
I wonder what kind of beautiful flowers of despair it will make bloom...
